set.body: Pilot-scoped harness slice (owner D1). Per protocol v3.1 §4 F10 and v0. Pin the official GLMsingle (Prince et al. 2022) at an exact commit and install it in an isolated venv (no global installs). Verify from its source and with a numeric check: beta units (percent signal change or not), the HRF library normalization, the type B/C/D outputs, and a low-noise (SNR 100) parity check for types C/D. If the gate fails, D5 becomes 'not run' before the pilot. Record the provenance and licence.
set.title: PHRF-CMP v0b: GLMsingle install, units and normalization gate
